thread:
maria: Heads-up — we need a timeboxed SIEM extract for vuln triage. Prod app logs for svc-payments from 2026-03-18 00:00 to 2026-03-19 06:00. Request will include unwrapped fields for full stack traces. Who can approve KMS unwrap and a scoped RBAC change?
dan: Can we avoid full unwrap? tokenized traces might be enough. What's the exact justification?
maria: Triage needs full traces to map exception to commit hashes and repro steps. This is for an active CVE investigation (CVSS 7.8) — SOC asked for a 48-hr snapshot. We'll timebox access to 6 hours for analysts.
sara: OK — two things: (1) a short-lived IAM role (analyst-temp-siem) with ReadExport role, TTL 6h; (2) KMS unwrap via a gateway that logs unwrap events to audit-bucket. Need sequence diagram + checklist.
leo: I can spin up the export job if we have the ticket and approvals. Template we use:
```
export_request = {
  "product": "svc-payments",
  "range": "2026-03-18T00:00:00Z/2026-03-19T06:00:00Z",
  "fields": ["timestamp","trace_id","stack","http.status"],
  "unwrap_kms": true,
  "ttl_hours": 6,
  "justification": "active CVE triage"
}
```
anya: Quick compliance note — exports with PII or customer identifiers require DLP scan before delivery. We should add a scrub step or mark files as restricted / ephemeral.
evan: For RBAC, we should create a JIT flow: request in ticketing, security review, then infra-automation-bot grants analyst-temp-siem for 6h and logs the grant. Can we automate approval if two engineers + a sec lead ack?
maria: That sounds fine. I'll add the approvals to the ticket. Also we need to ensure SIEM export bucket uses envelope encryption — the wrapper key is our export-key; KMS team needs to allow decrypt for the wrapper only when gateway unwraps.
oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1783 — assigned to maria. Reminder: follow just-in-time access policy.
infra-automation-bot: Pre-check results: export size estimate ~4.2GB, contains masked PII? unknown until DLP. Scheduled hold window OK. Run `siem export create --product svc-payments --start 2026-03-18T00:00Z --end 2026-03-19T06:00Z --fields trace,stack,http.status --unwrap-kms` after approvals.
dan: Please add explicit audit entries: who requested, who approved, who unwrapped, and KMS key version. Those must be in ticket and in audit stream.
sara: Also add retention override: exported snapshot TTL = 24h in export-bucket, auto-delete after 24h, and access logs retained for 365 days. That meets evidence needs but limits blast radius.
maria: I'll open the ticket with fields: requestor=maria, approvers=[dan,sara], reviewers=[sec-eng-lead]. Adding DLP step. @leo can you hold off starting job until infra-automation-bot executes?
leo: Yep. Waiting on ticket link.
anya: I'll add the compliance checklist and scanning rule to the ticket. If DLP flags customer IDs, we either redact or escalate to legal.
evan: After export complete, run quick integrity check and upload SHA256 to ticket for chain-of-custody.
maria: Thanks all. Ticket INC-2026-1783-EXPT created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2026-1783-EXPT. Approvals added. infra-automation-bot — please proceed with JIT grant and export when ready.
infra-automation-bot: Granting role analyst-temp-siem to users [maria, dan, leo] for 6h. Logging unwrap event to audit-bucket/export-unwraps with KMS key export-key:v3. Starting export job now. Job ID: export-20260319-11.
leo: Job kicked off — streaming logs to ephemeral bucket `tmp-extract-INC-2026-1783`.
sara: DLP scan queued. ETA ~12m.
anya: Copying compliance checklist into ticket.
maria: Once DLP passes, analysts will start triage. Please post any findings into the ticket; keep raw exports restricted to the analyst-role. :thumbsup:
evan: Postmortem action: propose adding a pre-approved JIT flow for vulnerability triage to avoid ad-hoc exceptions.
dan: Agreed — also propose a standard template for export justification to speed reviewers.
maria: Great. Closing loop after triage. Thanks everyone.
